entry.description: <untrusted_data>FX revaluation of EUR cash balance to period-end rate</untrusted_data>

payload.explanation:
This entry for 11,200.00 to account 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized is quarantined because it would double-count an FX revaluation already performed by the system, and the amount does not match expected revaluation figures.
- The system already translates the EUR and GBP balances of account 1110 Cash and Cash Equivalents at the period-end rate, so this 11,200.00 entry to account 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized would count the same FX gain or loss twice.
- The booked amount of 11,200.00 matches neither 10,730.20 (period-end versus average rate) nor 19,809.60 (period-end versus opening rate).
- This entry moves 11,200.00 on account 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized, which is 26.7% of its current balance of 42,000.00.
Next step: Confirm with finance who owns FX revaluation and ask the preparer for the revaluation workings and rate basis used before deciding whether to approve or reject this entry.

findings.message: The system already translates the EUR, GBP balances of 1110 Cash and Cash Equivalents at the period-end rate (or the configured fallback where one is missing), so this 11,200.00 entry to 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized would count the same FX gain or loss twice.
findings.suggested_action: Confirm with finance who owns FX revaluation (Clarifying Q1) before approving; if the system translation stands, reject this entry.
findings.title: FX revaluation would be double-counted

findings.message: Booked 11,200.00 matches neither 10,730.20 (period-end vs average rate) nor 19,809.60 (period-end vs opening rate). Excluded from the expected amounts (GBP): the rate table lacks a period-end, average or opening rate needed to value it.
findings.suggested_action: Ask the preparer for the revaluation workings and which rate basis they used.
findings.title: Revaluation amount does not match either rate basis

findings.message: This entry moves 11,200.00 on 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized, which is 26.7% of its current balance of 42,000.00.
findings.suggested_action: Confirm the amount with the preparer and check the supporting schedule.
findings.title: Large relative to the account balance

response.reason: The explanation clearly outlines the issues with specific amounts and accounts, and provides actionable next steps for the controller to resolve the quarantine.
